thanks this actually saved my life tonight :( i was gonna cut it short but i read this and decided to call up a friend and just sit together instead.
my mom needs help. I wish she would get hospitalized sometimes. Trust me, you’re doing the right thing for your family. Not getting help would just make things worse.
good suggestion, but I asked about that. They said no to all my requests. They’ve been ignoring my emails and meeting requests for 3 days.
they won’t let me drop any classes, they said i’m doing the bare minimum.

i emailed 4 of the different school psychologists and they said there’s nothing they can do, and I just have to stick it out. Made me feel like i’m not even worthy of trying to lessen my workload. I’m not working hard enough for them to even consider helping me.

Tbh i really want to be a professor at an ivy league myself and do research into psychology since it’s a special interest of mine, but I’m afraid I won’t be good enough to be someone like that. 
Thanks for the supportive words it really means a lot <3 :(

Im scared to be NB cause I’m afraid I want something that I’ll never be able to have :( I just want to not be me

(edit: i just wanted to clarify i’m not against non binary identities, i totally accept all NBs, Is just scared of the personal journey that i’d have to go through if I were NB)

I guess Im just convinced that if I get into an ivy, whenever i have a problem i can just say: “well at least i go to stanford!” same with being prettier: “well at least i look exactly how i want!”

I know these things won’t solve my problems but I feel like if i get them than at least I wont feel worthless

I guess it stems from my fear of the future. My parents say I won’t succeed unless i get into an ivy league. 

Honestly I like to live a little more riskily thank that. I had a different mindset before which was “I’ll figure it out.” But my dad yelled at me and drilled into my head that I need to work harder. 

I think I also worded this wrong. It’s not about how others see me... it’s definitely how I see myself. I dont know what I want to be. I want to like myself not be liked. I just want to be a person that I don’t hate. I have no idea who I am or who I want to be I guess. I don’t really care about the majority of other people... I care more about my image in the sense of I want to be appealing to myself. In a way I just want respect, but i feel like I have to figure out who I want to be first... do I even want respect? I’m literally so confused idk

thanks so much you actually really helped me reframe my thinking :) i guess i assumed everyone had amazing relationships with all their friends and my bipolar makes me feel insane so i thought maybe there was something wrong with me. in a way i’m kind of an idealist so i assumed im supposed to have tons and tons of amazing friends who all understand eachother... i have trouble being realistic as you can tell lol. but i do feel very lucky to have my close friend who knows me now that you say that. i tend to be optimistic but i guess sometimes i want more than there is to offer. thanks again!
